MODEL: PriorVLA
  Organization: Institute of Automation, CAS; Dexmal; UCAS; Zhongguancun Academy; Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
  Date: 2026-05-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10925
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Dual-expert flow-matching (frozen Prior Expert + trainable Adaptation Expert) over pi0.5-style VLM (SigLIP + Gemma-2B)
    Backbone: None
    LLM: None
    Parameters: Backbone: SigLIP vision encoder + Gemma-2B language model + flow-matching action expert (pi0.5-style); PriorVLA updates ~25% of the parameters that full fine-tuning would update. Absolute trainable count not stated.
  Tags: prior-preserving, peft, adaptation, libero, robotwin, few-shot, ood, flow-matching, expert-queries
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=99.05): libero_spatial=99.4, libero_object=99.8, libero_goal=99.4, libero_long=97.6, libero_avg=99.1
    robotwin_v2 (avg=52.8): grab_roller=93, handover_mic=84, lift_pot=66, move_can_pot=57, open_laptop=83, pick_dual_bottles=26, place_object_basket=42, place_dual_shoes=20, place_phone_stand=35, put_bottles_dustbin=45, put_object_cabinet=45, stack_blocks_two=17, stack_bowls_two=73, robotwin_v2_hard_avg=52.8, robotwin_v2_avg=52.8, robotwin_v2_hard_delta_vs_pi0_5=11.0
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned (50 demonstrations per task)', 'robotwin': 'fine-tuned (RoboTwin 2.0-Hard, 50 demonstrations per task)', 'real_world': '100-300 demonstrations per task standard; 10 demonstrations per task few-shot'}
  AI Review Summary: 사전학습된 π₀.₅ 류 VLA의 prior가 full fine-tuning 중 좁은 학습 분포로 드리프트하는 문제를 해결하기 위해, **frozen Prior Expert + 학습 가능한 Adaptation Expert**를 두고 3종의 Expert Query(Scene/Motor/Action)로 prior를 명시적으로 추출/주입하는 PEFT 프레임워크. Full fine-tune의 **25% 파라미터**만 갱신하면서 LIBERO **99.1%**, RoboTwin 2.0-Hard 평균 **52.8%**, 실로봇 standard 8
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: PLD
  Organization: NVIDIA GEAR Lab
  Date: 2025-10-30
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.00091
  Code: None
  Venue: ReALM-GEN Workshop @ ICLR 2026
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: plug-and-play residual RL framework (probe → learn → distill back to generalist)
    Backbone: varies (wraps existing VLAs)
    LLM: varies (wraps existing VLAs)
    Parameters: varies (applied on top of existing VLAs)
  Tags: residual-RL, probe-learn-distill, post-training, ICLR-2026-workshop
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=99.0): libero_avg=99.0
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'RL post-trained', 'simpler_env': 'RL post-trained'}
  AI Review Summary: NVIDIA GEAR/CMU의 PLD는 Probe(잔차 RL specialist 학습) → Learn(VLA prior로 base policy probing 후 specialist takeover) → Distill(SFT)의 3단계 post-training pipeline으로, π0/OpenVLA 모두에서 LIBERO 평균 99% 이상을 달성하고 SimplerEnv에서 +24.9%의 절대 개선을 기록한 self-improving 데이터 flywheel.
  AI Review: PDF-verified

MODEL: SimpleVLA-RL
  Organization: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Peking University / Shanghai AI Lab / HKU
  Date: 2025-09-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.09674
  Code: https://github.com/PRIME-RL/SimpleVLA-RL
  Venue: ICLR 2026
  Open Source: True
  Architecture:
    Action Head: autoregressive + GRPO reinforcement learning
    Backbone: PrismaticVLM (SigLIP + DinoV2)
    LLM: Llama-2 7B
    Parameters: 7B
  Inference: 10 Hz
  Tags: 7B, RL, GRPO, reinforcement-learning, ICLR-2026, open-source, SOTA, data-efficient
  Benchmarks:

  Organization: Affiliations from Shenzhen and Guangdong institutions (specific institutions not enumerated in arXiv abstract page; authors: Sixu Lin, Yunpeng Qing, Litao Liu, Ming Zhou, Ruixing Jin, Xiaoyi Fan, Guiliang Liu)

  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Two-stage cross-task RL framework. Stage 1 (offline pre-training): Information Bottleneck objective max I(Z;A) - lambda_IB * I(Z;O), implemented via variational lower bound L_base = E[-log pi(a|z)] + lambda_IB * MINE-style term. Stage 2 (online fine-tuning): Mixture-of-RL-Residuals (MoRR) — Delta_a = sum omega_i(z_T) * a_tilde_i, with routing omega over expert residual policies guided by task embeddings learned via contrastive loss. MODEL: LoopVLA
  Organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST), Wuhan United Imaging Surgical Co., Ltd.
  Date: 2026-05-11
  Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09948
  Code: None
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Recurrent refinement: first 4 transformer layers (Perceptual Anchor Layers, PAL) are frozen, then a shared 3-layer Loop Block is applied iteratively (up to 8 iterations) on multimodal tokens. Each iteration produces (a) a candidate action via the action head and (b) a halting probability via the sufficiency head. Remaining Mass Allocation (RMA) converts halting scores into a valid distribution p(n) = s(n)*r(n) over refinement steps. Two-stage training: Stage 1 supervises all intermediates with L1 + entropy/diversity regularization; Stage 2 calibrates halting distribution to action-quality-derived target via KL divergence.
    Backbone: Qwen3VL-2B-Instruction (SigLIP-2 visual encoder + 28-layer transformer decoder)
    LLM: None
    Parameters: LoopOFT*: 1.2B (vs 2.2B Qwen3OFT baseline, -45%); LoopFM: 1.3B (vs 2.3B Qwen3FM, -43%)
  Tags: libero, libero-plus, vla-arena, recurrent, sufficiency, early-exit, efficiency, qwen3-vl
  Benchmarks:
    libero (avg=95.85): libero_spatial=95.0, libero_object=100.0, libero_goal=97.4, libero_long=91.0, libero_avg=95.85
  Eval Conditions: {'libero': 'fine-tuned', 'libero_plus': 'zero-shot generalization (camera/robot/language/light/background factors)', 'vla_arena': 'fine-tuned; L0 (safety/distractor/extrapolation/long-horizon)'}
  AI Review Summary: "VLA backbone의 가장 깊은 표현이 항상 최적"이라는 통념을 정면 반박. 4 frozen Perceptual Anchor Layer 위에 3-layer shared Loop Block을 최대 8회 반복 적용하면서, 매 iteration마다 후보 action + sufficiency score를 산출. Remaining Mass Allocation(RMA)과 self-supervised distribution alignment로 "언제 멈출지"를 학습. Qwen3VL-2B에서 파라미터 -45%(2.2B→1.2B) + 처리량 
  AI Review: PDF-verified

  AI Review Summary: 순차 제어에서 **temporal error accumulation**으로 붕괴하는 VLA PTQ를, **Cross-Space Representation Compensation (CSRC) + Drift-Aware Mixed-Precision Allocation (DA-MPA)** 두 축으로 해결. CogACT W4A8에서 42.5% 메모리 감소 + 54.8% 속도 향상을 달성하면서 FP 대비 성능 손실을 최소화.

  Architecture:
    Action Head: Action decoder with recurrent scene prefix. Maintains a persistent action-updated scene state across chunked control calls. At each VLM call: (a) observation slots extract fresh visual evidence per-view; (b) prior slots inherit the scene state from the previous chunk; (c) action decoder jointly denoises the next action chunk AND a compact scene update via flow-matching ('Joint Action-Scene Denoising'). Two training-only auxiliaries: Scene Predictor (supervises future scene-token targets) and Geometric Anchor (two-level: local depth + global 3D foundation model teacher).     Action Head: Wraps a frozen VLA backbone with three components: an Episodic Memory Module (CLIP ViT-B/32 keyframe store with top-k cosine retrieval), a learned State Verifier (3-layer MLP 1024->512->256->1 predicting pre-execution failure probability from memory-augmented observation, action, and subgoal), and a Harness Controller that triggers rollback or replanning when failure is predicted.
    Backbone: model-agnostic wrapper (evaluated with OpenVLA and Octo backbones, both kept frozen)
    LLM: inherited from underlying VLA backbone (OpenVLA / Octo)
    Parameters: TODO
  Tags: wrapper, long-horizon, episodic-memory, failure-recovery, libero, calvin
  Benchmarks:
    libero: libero_long=81.5
    calvin (avg=3.58): calvin_abc_d_avg_len=3.58

MODEL: UniT

  Code: https://xpeng-robotics.github.io/unit/
  Venue: None
  Open Source: False
  Architecture:
    Action Head: Hybrid two-stage. (1) UniT Token Prediction: learnable queries q_t appended to the VLM sequence; VLM predicts discrete UniT codes c_t = UniT(o_t, o_{t+k}, a_{t:t+k}, s_t) via parallel cross-entropy classification (not causal next-token AR). (2) Flow-Matching action head V_θ on action chunks A_t = [a_t,...,a_{t+H-1}], τ ∈ U[0,1], interpolated path A^τ_t = τA_t + (1−τ)ε; trained with L_fm = E[||V_θ(A^τ_t | x_t, Enc(o_t), τ) − (A_t − ε)||²]. Total: L_VLA = L_token + λ_fm·L_fm.
    Backbone: frozen DINOv2 (visual branch acts as inverse-dynamics model anchor)

================================================================================
SECTION 3: BENCHMARK DEFINITIONS
================================================================================

LIBERO: 4 manipulation suites (Spatial, Object, Goal, Long-horizon)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.
  Primary ranking metric for VLA-Tracker.

CALVIN: Long-horizon language-conditioned manipulation (ABC→D setting)
  Score: Average number of tasks completed in sequence (0-5). Higher is better.

SimplerEnv: Sim-to-real transfer evaluation
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RoboTwin v1/v2: Bimanual dual-arm manipulation (50+ tasks)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RLBench: Diverse manipulation tasks (18 tasks)
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.

RoboCasa: Home robot manipulation tasks
  Score range: 0-100% success rate. Higher is better.
